title: Austin Stassney Wood Apartments Ownership Transfer
summary:
*   **Stassney Wood Apartments Ownership Transferred:** Approved the transfer of ownership and regulatory agreement for the bond-financed Stassney Wood Apartments.
*   **Continuity of Parent Company:** The apartments will remain under the ultimate ownership of Mid America Apartment Communities, Inc., transitioning to a newly created Texas Limited Partnership.
*   **Transfer Fee Paid:** The new limited partnership will pay a $12,900 transfer fee to the Austin Housing Finance Corporation for this transaction.

BOARD OF DIRECTOR'S MEETING
AUSTIN HOUSING FINANCE CORPORATION
MINUTES
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 6, 1997
The Board meeting of the Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) was convened at 4:15
p.m.
The following agenda item (set forth on the City of Austin Council Meeting agenda as item
21) was considered by the Austin Housing Finance Corporation's Board of Directors. 1.
Approve a resolution authorizing the assumption of regulatory agreement and consent to
transfer the ownership of the Stassney Wood Apartments, a bond financed project from
America First Austin REIT, Inc., affiliated with Texas Corporation and wholly owned
subsidiary of Mid America Apartment Communities, Inc., to a to be created Texas Limited
Partnership that will be a wholly owned subsidiary of Mid America Apartment Communities,
Inc., and authorize the General Manager or his designce to execute the necessary agreement
and other documents on behalf of the Corporation. (The new limited partnership will pay
all legal fees as well as a transfer fee to AHFC of $12,900 at closing.) AHFC Resolution
No. 97-0806-01 was approved on Board Member Goodman's motion, Vice President Garcia's
second by a 7-0 vote.
The meeting was adjourned at 4:40 p.m.
